approval.rationale: Face-on hand-made bricks in running bond with recessed lime joints; about a third of the bricks are soot-blackened in irregular patches that do not line up, so the 2 m tile reads as one old sooty wall rather than a repeating pattern.
limitations: The brick faces share one crackled surface texture, and the course heights are more regular than hand-made brick would be.
The candidate is very dark (linear albedo about 0.03); the cook lifts it with gain 2.4, which also lifts the noise in the soot.
No efflorescence, damp line or repairs; every course is intact.
